clue.text: Finished with sheep, I prepared beef

parts.note: something finished is past, over and done
a ram is a male sheep
taken as written

explanation.surface: A cook who has finished with the lamb turns to preparing the beef course.
explanation.walkthrough: PAST, RAM and I simply join in order to make PASTRAMI.
explanation.definitionFit: Pastrami is cured, seasoned and smoked brisket, so it is beef that has been specially treated before serving.

clue.text: Book theatre turns

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a book of the New Testament, following the Gospels
second meaning: short performances on a variety bill

explanation.surface: Someone books tickets for the turns at a variety theatre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Book' reads as a verb, booking a show, but it names the Bible book of the Apostles.
explanation.definitionFit: The Acts of the Apostles is a Bible book, and performers' routines on a variety stage are called acts.

clue.text: Photograph street badly

parts.note: St is the standard abbreviation for street
ill as an adverb means badly, as in ill-treated

explanation.surface: Someone takes a poor snapshot of a street scene.
explanation.definitionFit: A still is a single photograph, especially one taken from a film or for publicity, as opposed to moving footage.

clue.text: Note off-white colour

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a musical note that is neither sharp nor flat
second meaning: an unbleached creamy shade used in paints and fabrics

explanation.surface: A paint chart labels an off-white shade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Note' looks like 'take note of', but it is the musical sense.
explanation.definitionFit: In music a natural is a note restored from sharp or flat, and decorators sell a pale oatmeal shade called natural.

clue.text: Rich dish set before elite

indicators.note: before tells the solver the first piece goes ahead of the second when they are joined

parts.note: set means thickened or congealed, like clotted blood
the cream is the best part, the elite

explanation.surface: A lavish course is laid out in front of an exclusive gathering.
explanation.walkthrough: Clotted cream is the thick scalded cream of Devon and Cornwall, eaten with scones.
explanation.definitionFit: Thick scalded cream is a very rich food, served as part of a cream tea with jam and scones.

clue.text: Hybrid part associated with yellow bird

indicators.note: a hybrid is a mixture of different stock, so the following letters are mixed up

parts.note: taken as written, as anagram fodder
or is the heraldic name for gold or yellow

explanation.surface: A cross-bred component is linked with a yellow bird such as a canary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hybrid part' reads as a car component, but hybrid is the shuffle signal. OR comes from heraldry.
explanation.definitionFit: A raptor is a bird of prey such as a hawk, eagle or falcon, so it is one kind of bird.

clue.text: Coloured can bound not to contain one

parts.note: a tin is a can

indicators.note: not containing something means that thing must be taken out of the word before

parts.note: bound means tied up
the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A can is tied in a way that keeps something out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not to contain one' means the Roman numeral for one is removed from the word for bound, not placed inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tinted has been given a light colour or shade, as with tinted glass or tinted hair.

clue.text: What one sees on cutting annoyed group in the orchestra

parts.note: cross means angry or annoyed
the strings, brass and woodwind are each a section of the orchestra

explanation.surface: An irritated band of players sits within the orchestra.
explanation.definitionFit: Slicing through an object exposes its internal structure, the view called a cross-section in technical drawing and biology.

clue.text: United States mother's taken back girl

indicators.note: something taken back is returned the way it came, so read the word in the other direction

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother; the 's stands for 'is'
a girl's name

explanation.surface: A mother has taken her daughter back home.
explanation.definitionFit: America is the everyday short name for the United States, the country on the North American continent.

clue.text: Main song on disc kept for later use

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the featured track of a single, on the front of the record

definitions.note: adverb-like phrase; aside as in 'put aside'
definitions.meaning: second meaning: put by or reserved, as money set to one side

explanation.surface: A singer holds back their lead single for a later release.
explanation.walkthrough: The first meaning is written A-side; the hyphen disappears in the grid.
explanation.definitionFit: On a vinyl single the A-side carried the hit track, while money or food reserved for the future is put aside.

clue.text: New England state lacking a source of coal, perhaps

indicators.note: lacking means going without, so a letter is dropped from the state's name

parts.note: the north-eastern US state on the Atlantic coast
taken as written

explanation.surface: A New England state has no coal deposits.
explanation.walkthrough: Take the A out of MAINE. 'Perhaps' marks coal as just one thing a mine produces.
explanation.definitionFit: A colliery is a pit dug to extract coal, and a mine can equally yield gold, tin or diamonds.

clue.text: Forceful and muscular chaps break in to make an inspection

indicators.note: to break in is to force entry, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: to vet is to examine or check carefully
he-men are strong, macho men

explanation.surface: Strong, burly men barge in to search a place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Break in' looks like burglary, but it only tells the muscular chaps to go inside the word for inspecting.
explanation.definitionFit: Vehement describes something said or felt with great intensity and passion, which is a strong, powerful manner.

clue.text: Bother — basil sauce runs out before the end

indicators.note: running out before the end means stopping short, so the last letter is lost

parts.note: the Italian sauce of basil, pine nuts and cheese

explanation.surface: A cook is annoyed when the pesto runs out before the meal ends.
explanation.definitionFit: A pest is a nuisance or annoyance, and a bother is likewise something tiresome, both used as nouns here.

clue.text: Sickness started with fixed desire for inferior alcohol

indicators.note: how a word started is its opening letter

parts.note: the opening letter of the word
will is a determined wish or intention

explanation.surface: An illness began with a determined craving for cheap booze.
explanation.definitionFit: Swill is slang for poor-quality drink, the kind of cheap liquor or beer that is gulped rather than savoured.

clue.text: Right Ethiopians left broken alliance

indicators.note: broken things are smashed apart and put back in a different order

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for right
taken as written, as anagram fodder
L is the abbreviation for left

explanation.surface: A political coalition of Ethiopian right and left parties has collapsed.
explanation.definitionFit: An alliance is a connection or bond between parties, and a relationship is the same kind of association.

clue.text: Mischief-maker is the origin of mayhem on Florida island

indicators.note: the origin of a word is where it begins, its opening letter

parts.note: the opening letter of the word
taken as written
the Florida Keys are a chain of low islands, each called a key

explanation.surface: A troublemaker on a Florida island starts all the chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: Monkey is used affectionately for a cheeky, naughty child who gets into scrapes and causes trouble.

clue.text: Tear after mongrel now

indicators.note: after tells the solver the first-named piece is placed behind the second

parts.note: a cur is a mongrel dog
a rent is a rip or tear in cloth

explanation.surface: A torn garment follows a run-in with a stray dog, at this moment.
explanation.definitionFit: Current means present or happening at this time, so as an adjective it matches the sense of now.

clue.text: Personally successful female's upset about diamonds

indicators.note: about means around, so the rearranged letters surround the next piece
upset means knocked over and thrown into disorder, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, as anagram fodder
D is the card-playing abbreviation for diamonds

explanation.surface: A self-reliant woman is unhappy about her jewellery.
explanation.definitionFit: A self-made person has achieved wealth or success through their own efforts, without inherited advantage.

clue.text: Professional commodity no good in hosiery business

indicators.note: no means without, so a letter is taken away from the word it follows

parts.note: a stocking is an item of hosiery
G is the abbreviation for good
trade means commerce or business

explanation.surface: A worthless product turns up in the stockings trade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'No good' means drop the abbreviation for good, a common crossword convention.
explanation.definitionFit: Stock-in-trade is the goods a dealer keeps for sale, and figuratively the usual resources of a profession.

clue.text: Make a decision in favour of mining request

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
a miner stakes a claim to a plot of land

explanation.surface: A ruling backs a prospector's application for mining rights.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: to proclaim is to declare publicly, as a ruler announcing a decision.
explanation.definitionFit: To proclaim is to declare officially, announcing a ruling or decree to the public, which is how a decision is made known.

clue.text: Good source of nourishment is not ripe, unfortunately

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things have gone wrong, so the letters come out in the wrong order

parts.note: taken as written, as anagram fodder

explanation.surface: A wholesome food is regrettably unripe.
explanation.definitionFit: Protein is an essential nutrient found in meat, eggs and beans, needed by the body for growth and repair.

clue.text: View about national assembly

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece wraps around the other

parts.note: to view is to see
Nat is the abbreviation for national

explanation.surface: An opinion on the national parliament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'National assembly' looks like the definition, but national is part of the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A senate is a legislative or governing body, a formal gathering of members such as the upper house of a parliament.

clue.text: Tree ring, as it happens

parts.note: the letter O is ring-shaped
live broadcasting shows events as they happen

explanation.surface: A tree's growth ring appears, as luck would have it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'As it happens' looks like a throwaway phrase meaning by chance, but it means broadcast in real time.
explanation.definitionFit: The olive is a Mediterranean evergreen grown for its fruit and oil, so it is a species of tree.

clue.text: Travelled north in rainy environment

indicators.note: in tells the solver one piece sits inside the surroundings of another

parts.note: a rainy place is wet
N is the compass abbreviation for north

explanation.surface: Someone journeyed northwards through wet weather.
explanation.definitionFit: Went is the past tense of go, and travelled likewise describes having journeyed or moved somewhere.
